# AI360 Lab

> AI360 Lab is a practical AI workspace built from Accra by AI360 with the Accra Innovation Centre. It helps people research current information, understand difficult topics, make decisions, prepare proposals, plan work, and create coordinated campaign assets.

Canonical name: AI360
Product name: AI360 Lab
Creative workspace: AI360 Studio
Primary market: Ghana and Africa
Website: https://lab.aithreesixty.tech
Organization: https://aithreesixty.tech

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://lab.aithreesixty.tech/): Mission, audiences and core outcomes.
- [What you can do](https://lab.aithreesixty.tech/what-you-can-make): Examples of research, study, proposal, campaign and public-service work.
- [How it works](https://lab.aithreesixty.tech/how-it-works): Routing, live research, approval controls, privacy and production workflow.
- [Plans](https://lab.aithreesixty.tech/pricing): Free and paid plans, work credits, Mobile Money and card payment information.
- [Changelog](https://lab.aithreesixty.tech/changelog): Meaningful shipped, pilot and foundation updates with explicit release status.
- [Privacy](https://lab.aithreesixty.tech/privacy): Data handling and user choices.
- [Terms](https://lab.aithreesixty.tech/terms): Responsible use and service terms.

## Product facts

- AI360 Lab supports quick answers, sourced web research, document and media analysis, structured workflows, exports, campaign planning, image generation and video generation.
- People review plans, estimated credits and important actions before work proceeds.
- The service does not silently publish content, send messages or run paid media production.
- A free monthly allowance is available. Current plan details are published on the pricing page.
- Public marketing pages may be cited. Private workspaces, account pages and API routes should not be indexed.
